C45087.observed: What was checked: whether choosing "Print Work Order" opens the browser's own print dialog. What happened: it does. Selecting the item triggered the browser's print request - the page asked the browser to print exactly once, which is what opens the native print dialog for a real user. This was checked by watching for the browser print request rather than by letting the dialog open on screen, because a print dialog left open would stop the rest of the checks; the request being made is the same thing the user sees as the dialog appearing.
